label: loop
description: LOOP-2 niche: a two-action cycle (open_file, run_tests) dominates the run but never fires LOOP-1: it is regularly interrupted by a distinct, one-off check every single time, so the trailing exact-repeat block resets to 1-2 on every interruption and never reaches k. Only the n-gram coverage fallback catches it. All calls succeed and carry no test/exit-code/git evidence, so RetryDetector and NoProgressDetector also stay silent (verified in the go/no-go spike). Lives outside traces/ on purpose, mirroring tests/fixtures/retry_tool_storm.json: LOOP-2's n-gram confidence is capped below stop_threshold (a new, uncalibrated detection path), so this trace never STOPs on its own and therefore cannot serve as a must-be-caught golden loop trace under tests/test_replay.py::test_golden_loops_are_all_caught.
